key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often AI Usage Stats refreshes local usage data.

key.name: log-root
key.description: Directory containing local Codex JSONL session logs.

key.name: panel-show-usage
key.summary: Show usage next to the panel icon
key.description: When enabled, the top bar shows the compact gauges of the top bar provider next to the icon.

key.name: cache-enabled
key.description: Store parsed token metadata in the user cache directory for faster refreshes.

key.name: account-limits-enabled
key.description: Ask the local Codex CLI for the current account rate-limit snapshot when available.

key.name: panel-provider
key.description: Which provider's gauges the top bar shows (codex, claude, grok or opencode). Empty means no provider has been picked yet and the panel shows a placeholder.

key.name: claude-enabled
key.description: Show Claude Code in the popover when its sessions root exists. Token usage is read locally; live 5h/weekly limits require the statusLine capture.

key.name: claude-log-root
key.description: Directory containing local Claude Code JSONL session transcripts.

key.name: claude-limits-file
key.description: JSON file the statusLine capture writes with Claude 5h/weekly rate-limit metadata.

key.name: claude-online-usage
key.description: Opt-in. When enabled, the helper makes a network request to the Anthropic usage API using your local Claude login token to read live 5h/weekly and per-model (Fable/Opus) limits. Off by default to keep the extension fully local. Only numeric usage metadata is read.

key.name: grok-enabled
key.description: Show Grok Build in the popover when its home directory exists. Per-turn token counts and the weekly credit percentage are read locally.

key.name: grok-log-root
key.description: Directory containing local Grok Build session usage files and the unified log.

key.name: opencode-enabled
key.description: Show OpenCode in the popover when its data directory exists. Only numeric token counts are read from the local database.

key.name: opencode-log-root
key.description: Directory containing the local OpenCode SQLite database.
